newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates seesaw to end up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates seesaw to end up.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates fluctuated widely before ending higher on Sunday and are expected to open at similar levels on Monday, dealers said.
Onvernight funds were offered initially at 16 percent and considerable amounts changed hands in the range of 11 percent and 13 percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
The rates crashed down to nine percent but were jacked up by lenders, and the closing deals were seen at 20 percent.
